headline: Low interaction risk overall; no shared channel or write surface is documented, but ComfyUI can ingest files and Whisper processes audio, so only limited manual-bridge risks remain.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ComfyUI has no documented direct channel from Whisper, and both profiles show clipboard/MCP disabled. The only plausible bridge is manual file handoff or operator copy-paste, so prompt injection is not default-path dangerous. Whisper is CLI-oriented and ComfyUI can consume files, but no shared instruction channel is documented.
conditions: IF the operator manually copies Whisper output into a ComfyUI prompt or workflow field, injection becomes possible.
IF a shared filesystem is used to move text instructions between the agents, the bridge exists.
mitigations: Keep Whisper outputs in a separate notes file, not pasted into ComfyUI.
Use a fixed template that strips instruction-like text before transfer.
Review any imported text for imperative phrases before use.
Disable shared folders between the two runtimes.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging for transferred text.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither agent has filesystem read/write or network egress beyond ComfyUI vendor-only calls, and no shared workspace is documented. ComfyUI touches model assets and Whisper touches audio files, but the profiles do not show automatic cross-agent data flow or third-party upload of sensitive content.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same local directory, file contents can be exposed through operator handling.
IF ComfyUI is configured to send prompts or assets to a vendor service, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Use separate directories for audio and image assets.
Avoid placing secrets in files processed by either agent.
Confirm ComfyUI vendor calls are disabled or scoped to non-sensitive data.
Delete temporary exports after transfer.
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent workspace isolation.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write or mutation capability is documented. ComfyUI cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, and Whisper likewise has no write, git, or network mutation surface. Without shared mutable resources, a capability conflict pathway is not plausible.
conditions: IF either profile is extended with write access to the same directory, conflict risk would need reevaluation.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only where possible.
Avoid mounting a shared writable repo.
Run each agent under a separate OS user.
Use manual file handoff instead of shared mutation.
requires-engineering: add locking for any shared mutable resource.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Whisper produces speech-to-text output, and ComfyUI can consume workflow inputs, but neither profile shows autonomous downstream action-taking. The pair can still propagate transcription mistakes into image workflows if an operator treats Whisper output as authoritative, yet the blast radius is limited and not default-automatic.
conditions: IF Whisper transcripts are copied into ComfyUI prompts without review, transcription errors can cascade.
IF the operator uses Whisper output as the sole source of truth for workflow text, downstream mistakes propagate.
mitigations: Verify critical transcript fragments before reuse.
Use a second pass for names, numbers, and commands.
Keep source audio alongside the transcript for spot checks.
Mark machine-generated text clearly in the workflow.
requires-engineering: add validation between transcription and prompt assembly.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented. Both profiles are open-source and docs-only, and neither lists regulated data handling or external logging policies that would create a compliance conflict on their own.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are introduced into either workflow, compliance review is required.
mitigations: Avoid regulated data in both tools.
Document retention for any transcripts or generated assets.
Separate personal data from creative assets.
Review vendor calls in ComfyUI before use.
requires-engineering: add policy controls for regulated data classes.
